packageRules.description: MkDocs 2.0 removes the plugin and hook system the documentation site (mkdocs.yml, scripts/site/hooks.py) relies on; moving off 1.x is a migration, not a bump.
openapi-typescript 7 needs TypeScript 5's compiler API (peer ^5.x); TypeScript 7 is the native port without it.

The Talos machinery module sets the rendered configuration and the supported contract: no ordinary update merges automatically until a CI test compares rendered output (docs/spec/compilation.md §10.2, ginsys/bronzeward#1212). Its own group, so it does not stop automerge for the rest of go-patch. This does not reach a security fix: Renovate applies the vulnerabilityAlerts settings after every package rule, so a security fix still merges automatically unless those are changed for the whole repository.
A machinery minor or major is deliberate work (compilation.md §10.2): opened only when ticked on the Dependency Dashboard.
